entities.text: Mohammed Khalimoddin Mohamd ... vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner/accused No.2 seeking to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.187 of 2024 on the file of Kothapalli Police Station, Karimnagar, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 447, 427, 120-B, 467, 468, 471, 420, 387 and 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
2. Heard Sri M.A.K.Mukheed, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S. Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3.
As seen from the record, the averments of the petition do not constitute offences under Section 467 of IPC.

Hence, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 27.06.2024 between 11:00 a.m. and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall submit his defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.

Further,
if the petitioner is not cooperating with the investigation, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to take action in accordance with the law.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
